meta_title: Telford Boiler Repairs | Emergency Boiler Plumber
meta_description: Telford Boiler Repairs offers fast emergency boiler repairs and installations across Telford. Same-day service, Gas Safe registered. Call now.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken in Telford? We arrive within the hour, diagnose the problem, and get your heating back on—any time, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system upgrades, we handle every aspect of boiler maintenance and installation.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Your boiler's broken and you need heat now. We carry common parts on the van and aim to fix most faults on the first visit, any time of day or night.

services.title: Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler checks keep your system running safely and efficiently, reduce breakdown risk, and protect your warranty. We'll spot minor issues before they become costly.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: Upgrading to a new combi, system, or conventional boiler? We handle the lot—survey, disconnection, installation, and commissioning—plus a 10-year parts and labour guarantee.

services.title: Heating System Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old radiators, fit thermostatic valves, install smart controls, or upgrade your entire heating system. Lower bills, better comfort, and modern efficiency.

services.title: Power Flushing
services.desc: If your radiators are cold at the bottom or your heating is sluggish, power flushing removes sludge and restores full system performance.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Checks
services.desc: Stay compliant with annual mandatory safety inspections. We issue your Gas Safety Certificate on the spot and flag any issues that need fixing.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing homeowners ripped off by cowboys charging £500 for a £50 fix.
about_para_1: Telford Boiler Repairs was founded 15 years ago on a simple principle: honest diagnosis, fair pricing, and fixing boilers properly the first time. Over a decade and a half, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, explaining what's wrong, and getting families back to warm homes without unnecessary cost. We're Gas Safe Registered and we carry full insurance on every job.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, we're upfront about prices, and we don't try to sell you a new boiler when a repair will do the job. Around 40% of our new work comes from referrals—that's how you know we're doing something right. We're proud to serve Telford and the surrounding areas, and we treat every home like it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Telford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a Sunday evening in December—absolute nightmare. Phoned Telford Boiler Repairs as a last resort and they were here within an hour. Mark diagnosed a faulty pump, fixed it, and we had heating and hot water back by 9pm. Fair price, no faffing about. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Robert T.

reviews.text: Had my annual service done last month. The engineer was polite, thorough, and showed me exactly what he was checking. Nice to deal with someone who doesn't try to upsell you on stuff you don't need. Will be using them again next year.
reviews.author: Emma P.

reviews.text: New boiler installation with these guys. Took a couple of days, very clean, no mess left behind. They walked me through how to use the new controls and left me with all the paperwork. Came in on budget and the 10-year guarantee is peace of mind. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: David H.
